# List of Abbreviations {.unnumbered}

*List every abbreviation that appears more than once in the body. Define abbreviations that appear only once inline at first use instead. Keep the list alphabetical.*

<!--
Use a Markdown definition list: the term on one line, a blank line,
then an indented colon-definition. Quarto renders this as a clean
two-column layout in the PDF.
-->

BLDC
:   Brushless Direct Current (motor)

DE
:   Differential Evolution

FEA
:   Finite Element Analysis

FOC
:   Field-Oriented Control

IMU
:   Inertial Measurement Unit

LQR
:   Linear Quadratic Regulator

MCU
:   Microcontroller Unit

PID
:   Proportional-Integral-Derivative

RQ
:   Research Question

# Nomenclature {.unnumbered}

*Optional but recommended once the thesis uses more than a handful of mathematical symbols. List every symbol used in equations, with units in parentheses. Group by Latin then Greek, or keep one alphabetical list.*

$E$
:   Young's modulus (Pa)

$g$
:   Gravitational acceleration (m/s²)

$K_p, K_i, K_d$
:   Proportional, integral, derivative gains of the PID controller

$L$
:   Distance from pivot to centre of mass (m)

$M_p$
:   Mass of the pendulum body (kg)

$r$
:   Wheel radius (m)

$\bm{d}$
:   Nodal displacement vector

$\bm{F}$
:   External nodal force vector

$\bm{K}$
:   Stiffness matrix

$\alpha$
:   Gravitational instability coefficient (rad²/s²)

$\varepsilon$
:   Engineering strain

$\theta$
:   Pitch angle measured from vertical (rad)

$\sigma$
:   Engineering stress (Pa)

$\sigma_y$
:   Yield strength (Pa)
